bestBets.overview: There looks to be quite a bit of pace in this race so it will be interesting to see where AZZURRI QUEEN can set up. She was rock-solid in defeat on debut and could set up to have last crack here. XUXA KISS could certainly come a long a fitter horse after that return run at Wang on wet. MILLIONAIRE LOVER was well backed on debut and showed the speed to lead it, but he was really no match at all in the finish. Not dismissing the thought he could make sudden improvement. Others like ISLE OF MONA, KUNG FU PANDA and OXLEY TYCOON were well in the market at their debuts and both return from a break. Bit wary about BALLERINI. Has switched over here and jumped out quite well at Mornington in mid July.

raceTips.comment: Millionaire Lover could be worth another chance on an improving track. He was heavily backed on debut at Seymour, firming from $4.60 to $3.50 before leading and folding up late on a testing Heavy 9. His trials suggest he is a better horse than what he dished up and the drop back to 1000m seems the right choice. Azzuri Queen was posted deep and stuck on well when narrowly beaten at Moe in fast time. Oxley Tycoon got it all wrong on debut and returns now as a gelding. It's noticeable the stable have taken a different approach this campaign, attempting to ride him quiet in two trials. The application of ear muffs is another pointer of trying to get him to relax. Mindful he may be ridden off the pace and is still learning how to harness his energy.

raceTips.comment: Reece Goodwin has been patient with finding the right races for Magnardo and the decision to scratch from Pakenham on Monday to target this race seems justified. She was forced to work hard in a fast-run race at Ballarat last start and still found enough to hold on late. Keeping her fresh and trialling between races has worked previously and loved her hit-out at Pakenham on July 21, which indicates she has bounced through her last start and is still thriving. She has the early speed to overcome the wide draw and is well placed to win again. Racetothebottom lacked gate speed first-up and then was too far back to make an impression but still worked to the line well when third to Sub Gauge. If he can show more speed out of the barriers and stay in touch with Magnardo, he may be able to threaten her late. Blondie's Toronado is racing well but she too has a lack of gate speed and may end up settling off the pace from her wide draw.

bestBets.overview: A short sprint to finish the day and it looks relatively competitive but dare say MY CHINA PLATE is the one the others have to beat. A new 3YO, she came here on July 13 and lived right up to all expectations, running faster time than the BM56 on the day (which to be fair was a couple of hours later in the day). Runner-up Captive Rock runs earlier in the day which gives us a handy late form reference. Nugent stays on here and the filly draws to just camp happily on the pace again. There's a few others that may want the front more so a 1-1 trail might work well.

raceTips.comment: Dismantle can test the favourite My China Plate and is an attractive bet at $7.50. She ran well when ridden conservatively on a heavy track at Moe and assuming had an issue when effectively pulled up out of the race at Bendigo. Her jump-out at Cranbourne last week was superb and suspect she will be ridden more aggressive from the inside draw. Only knock on My China Plate is the odds that are on offer. She was very impressive winning on debut at this track and distance in slick time and seemed to do it in second gear. Tough to beat for sure, just not prepared to back her at $1.50.
